items.name: Paneer Tikka
items.description: Char-grilled cottage cheese cubes marinated in yogurt and spices

items.name: Chicken Seekh Kebab
items.description: Skewered minced chicken seasoned with herbs and grilled in tandoor

items.name: Paneer Butter Masala
items.description: Cottage cheese cubes cooked in a rich, creamy tomato gravy

items.name: Butter Chicken
items.description: Tandoori chicken pieces simmered in a velvety butter tomato sauce

items.name: Mango Lassi
items.description: Traditional yogurt based drink blended with sweet mango pulp

items.name: Masala Chai
items.description: Brewed black tea with a mixture of aromatic Indian spices and herbs

items.name: Lotsa Loaded Tots
items.description: Crispy potato tots loaded with hot queso, crispy bacon and green onions. Served with Sriracha ketchup.

items.name: Maker's Mark Wings
items.description: Eight jumbo chicken wings served hot and crispy, tossed in our sweet and smoky BBQ bourbon sauce made with Maker's Mark. Served with celery sticks and your choice of Ranch or Bleu Cheese dressing.

items.name: Mountain o' nachos
items.description: Fresh tortilla chips piled high and smothered with spicy ground beef and melted queso, topped with black beans, jalapeños, tomatoes, lettuce, fresh guacamole and sour cream. Serves three to four.

items.name: Buffalo Wings
items.description: Eight jumbo chicken wings served hot and crispy in our Original sauce. Served with your choice of Ranch or Bleu Cheese dressing.

items.name: Pretzel Dogs
items.description: Meaty all-beef franks wrapped in sweet pretzel dough, fresh baked and served with spicy habanero dipping sauce.

items.name: Bar burgers & Wings platter
items.description: Everyone's two favorites, all on one plate! Four mini-cheeseburgers on King's Hawaiian® rolls, paired with our Original Buffalo Wings. Served with seasoned french fries.

items.name: Parmesan Garlic Chicken Caesar
items.description: Sautéed chicken breast, crusted in Parmesan and served over romaine lettuce with garlic-cheese croutons and Parmesan cheese, and tossed with Roasted Garlic Caesar dressing.

items.name: Thai Chicken Chop Salad
items.description: Fresh, crisp salad greens, shredded veggies, marinated garlic chicken, cilantro and scallions tossed in a zesty Thai sesame ginger and peanut dressing, topped with giant crispy wonton chips.

items.name: Grilled Chicken & Artichoke Pasta
items.description: Flame-grilled chicken breast served over multigrain penne pasta tossed in a garlic, olive oil and white wine sauce with oven-roasted tomatoes, spinach, artichoke hearts and fresh basil, then topped with shredded Parmesan cheese.

items.name: Chimichurri Sirloin Steak
items.description: 8 oz. fire-grilled sirloin topped with Latin chimichurri sauce, served with roasted tricolored potatoes and fresh baby greens tossed in Balsamic Herb Vinaigrette with oven-roasted tomatoes and shredded Manchego cheese.

items.name: Bass® Ale Battered Fish & Parmesan Potato Chips
items.description: 8 oz. wild-caught, sustainably sourced Pacific cod filet, Bass® Ale battered and fried until golden brown and crispy, served with crunchy Parmesan-dusted house-made Yukon Gold potato chips and creamy malt vinegar aioli.

items.name: Teriyaki Sirloin Steak
items.description: Fire-grilled 8 oz. sirloin marinated and glazed with our sweet teriyaki sauce. Served with loaded garlic mashed potatoes and crispy frazzled onions.

items.name: Buster's™ Cheeseburger
items.description: A seasoned half-pound burger, grilled and topped with American cheese and served on a toasted brioche bun.

items.name: Hot & Sugary Donut Bites
items.description: A basketful of warm sugarcoated plain and chocolate donut holes with raspberry and chocolate dipping sauces.

items.name: Bananas Foster Pie
items.description: Chilled banana pudding and vanilla sponge cake layered in a cinnamon-graham pastry with rum sauce and warm caramel.

items.name: Triple Layer Chocolate Cake
items.description: Alternating layers of rich, creamy frosting and moist, decadent cake topped with a fudge drizzle and a dusting of fine cocoa.

items.name: Decadent Chocolate Fondue
items.description: Fluffy marshmallows, crisp graham crackers, strawberry and banana slices, pound cake and brownie bites, all surrounding a warm fondue pot filled with rich, melted chocolate.

items.name: Ginormous Brownie Sundae
items.description: Chocolate chip pecan brownies with vanilla bean ice cream, covered in chocolate, caramel and raspberry sauces and fresh strawberries. Topped off with whipped cream and a cherry.

items.name: Rich & Creamy Cheesecake
items.description: Our classic NY cheesecake with graham cracker crust. Served with warm caramel and pecans or with berry sauce.

items.name: Handmade Shakes
items.description: Made with real ice cream, hand-dipped and blended until smooth. Available in chocolate, vanilla and strawberry.

items.name: Salted Caramel & Pecan Cheesecake
items.description: House-made caramel scented cheesecake with fresh blackberries & orange segments - gluten friendly.

items.name: Tasting Trio
items.description: mini versions of our white chocolate brownie, sticky toffee pudding + salted caramel & pecan cheesecake, served with french vanilla ice cream.
